calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 2

UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', count(*) - count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return', count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, count(*) n, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales) ctrl_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctrl_before, sum(r.returns_net) ctrl_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

-- web returns by processing store, and web lines by store, in the window
SELECT 'ret' src, s.store_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) amt
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines', s.store_id, count(*), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2026-01-05' GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) amt
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND s.store_id<>900 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
